# The same sale as `the_thousand_usd_sold_with_the_gain_written_out.txt`, with
# nothing saying which split is the difference.
#
# This is the shape every book written before `took_the_residual` existed is in.
# A ledger declaring `$residual$` produced exactly these splits — the token
# resolves to an amount and the amount is what was stored — and the release that
# imported it had no key to write. So the book records the disposal, the cost
# basis it drew on, and the gain in an income account, and records nothing about
# which of its splits the gain is.
#
# Read on its own the page states `realized_gains_fx: 0.00`, because a balanced
# transaction applies the same arithmetic to every one of its splits and no split
# claims the difference. Naming the account with `--fx-gain-account` is what
# supplies the missing fact.
#
# `{usd_basis}` is the guid of the purchase's cost basis, read from
# `fx-balances` after the first import.
2026-06-01 * "Sell every dollar at 1.40"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Bank -1000.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "-1300.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "{usd_basis}"
	Assets:CAD Bank 1400.00 CAD
	Income:FX Gain -100.00 CAD
